segments.zh: 我们要去参加晚宴，而不是去海滩。

segments.en: Wear this shirt with the silk tie I bought you and these corduroy pants.
segments.zh: 穿这件衬衫和我给你买的丝绸领带和这些灯芯绒裤子。

segments.en: It's chilly outside, so you can wear this coat.
segments.zh: 外面很冷，所以你可以穿这件外套。

segments.en: Thanks, honey.
segments.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的。

segments.en: You have such great fashion sense.
segments.zh: 你有这么大的时尚感。

segments.en: Alright, we're back, so now let's start with Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们回来了，现在让我们从 Fluency Builder 开始。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: OK, these are classic couple phrases, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，这些是经典的情侣短语，对吧？

segments.en: These are phrases you hear among couples, and the first one is maybe more common to hear from the female end, but it's not unknown on the male end.
segments.zh: 这些是你在夫妻中听到的短语，第一个可能更常见的是从女性一端听到的，但在男性方面并不为人所知。

segments.en: So, we have this question.
segments.zh: 所以，我们有这个问题。

segments.en: Do you like the way this looks?
segments.zh: 你喜欢这个样子吗？

segments.en: So while the person is saying this, they would maybe be moving to the side a little bit.
segments.zh: 因此，当这个人这么说时，他们可能会稍微移动到一边。

segments.en: Modeling it.
segments.zh: 建模它。

segments.en: Do you like the way this looks?
segments.zh: 你喜欢这个样子吗？

segments.en: So basically you're saying, do you like what I'm wearing?
segments.zh: 所以基本上你是说，你喜欢我穿的衣服吗？

segments.en: Does it look good on me?
segments.zh: 我穿起来好看吗？

segments.en: Does it look good?
segments.zh: 它看起来不错吗？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: You could also say, hey, I like the way this looks when you're trying to buy something at the store.
segments.zh: 你也可以说，嘿，我喜欢你在商店里买东西时的样子。

segments.en: And so, do you like the way this looks is a way for you to ask the other person's opinion of how you look.
segments.zh: 因此，您是否喜欢这种外观是您询问对方对您的外表的看法的一种方式。

segments.en: And also, another common phrase, especially with men who have no fashion sense, the wife says, what am I going to do with you?
segments.zh: 而且，另一个常用短语，尤其是没有时尚感的男人，妻子说，我要对你做什么？

segments.en: OK, this is an interesting phrase and it needs some explanation, I think, because the meaning is, well, this is very difficult, right?
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个有趣的短语，我认为它需要一些解释，因为意思是，嗯，这很困难，对吧？

segments.en: So you're being difficult or, wow, you need some help from me.
segments.zh: 所以你很困难，或者，哇，你需要我的帮助。

segments.en: I'm going to help you.
segments.zh: 我会帮助你的。

segments.en: How am I going to help you this much or all the time like this?
segments.zh: 我将如何像这样或一直帮助你这么多？

segments.en: Right, because she's pretty much saying he has no idea about clothing and fashion.
segments.zh: 对，因为她几乎说他对服装和时尚一无所知。

segments.en: So he's saying to her, what am I going to do with you?
segments.zh: 所以他对她说，我要对你做什么？

segments.en: It means you need so much help.
segments.zh: 这意味着你需要很多帮助。

segments.en: Seriously.
segments.zh: 说真的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And the third phrase that we saw and we said at the very beginning is fashion sense.
segments.zh: 我们一开始看到和说的第三个短语是时尚感。

segments.en: OK, so this is actually what the man needs help with.
segments.zh: 好的，这实际上是这个人需要帮助的。

segments.en: He needs help with his fashion sense because he has zero fashion sense.
segments.zh: 他在时尚感方面需要帮助，因为他的时尚感为零。

segments.en: And this is pretty much a way to say how much someone knows about fashion or appearances.
segments.zh: 这几乎是一种表达人们对时尚或外表了解多少的方式。

segments.en: And so I can say, oh, my friend Kathy, she has amazing fashion sense.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，哦，我的朋友凯西，她有惊人的时尚感。

segments.en: So she always looks good.
segments.zh: 所以她总是看起来很好。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So combining colors appropriately or wearing the right types of shoes with the right types of clothing, et cetera, fashion sense.
segments.zh: 因此，将颜色适当地结合或穿着正确类型的鞋子与正确类型的服装，等等，时尚感。

segments.en: Or even just being able to wear things that are good on her or telling other people what's good on them.
segments.zh: 甚至只是能够穿对她有好处的东西或告诉别人对他们有什么好处。

segments.en: So fashion sense is the ability to identify fashion and look good and make other people look good.
segments.zh: 所以时尚感是识别时尚和好看并让其他人看起来不错的能力。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Let's listen to this dialogue for the very last time and we'll come back and talk a little bit more about fashion because it's a very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 让我们最后一次听这个对话，我们会回来多谈谈时尚，因为这是一个非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: It is.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: Honey, come on.
segments.zh: 亲爱的，快点。

segments.en: We're going to be late.
segments.zh: 我们要迟到了。

segments.en: Honestly, you take longer getting ready than I do.
segments.zh: 老实说，你需要比我更长的时间来准备。

segments.en: I was drying my hair and ironing my shirt.
segments.zh: 我刚才在吹头发、熨衬衫。

segments.en: Can you come here for a sec?
segments.zh: 你能来这里一会儿吗？

segments.en: I need your help.
segments.zh: 我需要你帮忙。

segments.en: What is it?
segments.zh: 怎么了？

segments.en: Why are all these clothes on the bed?
segments.zh: 为什么所有这些衣服都在床上？

segments.en: I don't know what to wear.
segments.zh: 我不知道穿什么。

segments.en: OK, give me your opinion.
segments.zh: 好的，给我你的意见。

segments.en: Do you like the way this looks?
segments.zh: 你喜欢这个样子吗？

segments.en: The striped short sleeve shirt with this checkered sweater, my lucky sandals.
segments.zh: 条纹短袖衬衫搭配这件格纹毛衣，我的幸运凉鞋。

segments.en: I like the cut and hemline of these shorts.
segments.zh: 我喜欢这条短裤的剪裁和裤脚设计。

segments.en: So I think I'll wear these as well.
segments.zh: 所以我想就穿这条了。

segments.en: Are you joking?
segments.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

segments.en: What am I going to do with you?
segments.zh: 我真拿你没办法。

segments.en: We're going to a dinner party, not to the beach.
segments.zh: 我们要去参加晚宴，而不是去海滩。

segments.zh: 穿上我给你买的丝绸领带和这些灯芯绒裤子的衬衫。

segments.en: It's chilly outside so you can wear this coat.
segments.zh: 外面很冷，所以你可以穿这件外套。

segments.en: Thanks, honey.
segments.zh: 谢谢你，亲爱的。

segments.en: You have such great fashion sense.
segments.zh: 你有这么大的时尚感。

segments.zh: 现在，我要用我的头发做什么？

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: You lived in Italy for a while.
segments.zh: 你在意大利住了一段时间。

segments.en: How is the fashion over there?
segments.zh: 那边的时尚怎么样？

segments.en: Is it extreme like we see on the runways?
segments.zh: 是不是像我们在跑道上看到的那样极端？

segments.en: Because I honestly don't understand fashion.
segments.zh: 因为我真的不懂时尚。

segments.en: Well, the thing about runways is that that's not how normal people dress.
segments.zh: 好吧，关于跑道的事情是，这不是正常人的穿着方式。

segments.en: Well, yeah, that's what I understand.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的，这就是我的理解。

segments.en: Why do they have these fashion shows if people don't really buy these types of clothing?
segments.zh: 如果人们不真正购买这些类型的服装，他们为什么会有这些时装秀？

segments.en: Well, sometimes people like stores, for example, big stores, department stores will buy fashions off of the runway and they'll kind of change them a little bit so that they're more appropriate for normal consumption.
segments.zh: 好吧，有时人们喜欢商店，例如大商店，百货商店会在 T 台上购买时装，他们会稍微改变一下，这样它们就更适合正常消费。

segments.en: That means for normal people who want to wear them.
segments.zh: 这对于想要穿它们的普通人来说意味着。

segments.en: But the runway fashions are actually, they're kind of like exaggerations of trends that will happen in the shopping world, right, in the commercial world.
segments.zh: 但实际上，时装秀是对购物世界中将发生的趋势的夸大，对，在商业世界中。

segments.en: So the things that you see are like big, blown up exaggerations.
segments.zh: 所以你看到的东西就像大的，夸大的夸张。

segments.en: And we take bits and pieces of those in our daily lives to dress up.
segments.zh: 我们拿一些日常生活中的人来打扮。

segments.en: So different colors or fabrics or like oftentimes you see kind of military outfits.
segments.zh: 所以不同的颜色或面料，或者像你经常看到的军装。

segments.en: And so that will translate into military jackets that are very popular one season.
segments.zh: 因此，这将转化为一个非常受欢迎的军用夹克。

segments.en: And so Italy definitely counts as a very fashionable country, but it's not crazy.
segments.zh: 所以意大利绝对是一个非常时尚的国家，但这并不疯狂。

segments.en: Well, every once in a while you see some more crazy clothes, but I think Japan is much more crazy as far as style.
segments.zh: 好吧，每隔一段时间你就会看到一些更疯狂的衣服，但我认为日本在风格方面更加疯狂。

segments.en: Yeah, actually, yeah.
segments.zh: 是的，实际上，是的。

segments.en: Asian countries such as Japan or South Korea, they have very, also unique fashion as well, but it's very extreme to a certain point.
segments.zh: 亚洲国家，如日本或韩国，它们也有非常非常独特的时尚，但在一定程度上是非常极端的。

segments.en: And the color combinations they do is like red sneakers with green pants and like a blue jacket.
segments.zh: 他们所做的颜色组合就像红色运动鞋搭配绿色裤子和蓝色夹克。

segments.en: It's very crazy.
segments.zh: 这是非常疯狂的。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And very bright.
segments.zh: 而且非常明亮。

segments.en: And you often see these shoes, you know, we call them platform shoes.
segments.zh: 你经常看到这些鞋，你知道，我们称它们为厚底鞋。

segments.en: It's kind of like you're standing on a brick.
segments.zh: 这有点像你站在砖上。

segments.en: Yeah, they're huge.
segments.zh: 是的，它们是巨大的。

segments.en: And they're, you know, they're seven inches tall.
segments.zh: 他们是，你知道，它们有七英寸高。

segments.en: And you see these little girls wearing these big shoes.
segments.zh: 你看到这些小女孩穿着这些大鞋。

segments.en: And I just, I'm so scared when I see them because I feel like they're going to fall over.
segments.zh: 我只是，当我看到他们时我很害怕，因为我觉得他们会摔倒。

segments.en: The other thing is that fashion is so expensive.
segments.zh: 另一件事是时尚如此昂贵。

segments.en: If you actually want to buy something that's in like an authentic, I don't know, Carolina Herrera or Oscar de la Renta or something like that.
segments.zh: 如果你真的想买一些像正宗的东西，我不知道，Carolina Herrera 或 Oscar de la Renta 或类似的东西。

segments.en: It's so expensive.
segments.zh: 它太贵了。

segments.en: It is.
segments.zh: 确实如此。

segments.en: But you know, high fashion is expensive.
segments.zh: 但你知道，高级时装是昂贵的。

segments.en: Fashion is not, doesn't have to be.
segments.zh: 时尚不是，不一定是。

segments.en: You can be fashionable just looking at different stores and going to secondhand shops and making your own clothes.
segments.zh: 你可以只看不同的商店，去二手店，自己做衣服，就很时尚。

segments.en: I mean, it's all about a sense of personal style and dressing yourself to be unique.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这一切都是关于个人风格的感觉，并把自己打扮成独特的感觉。

segments.en: Or you can get it at the fake market.
segments.zh: 或者你可以在假市场买到。

segments.en: Or you can go to the fake market.
segments.zh: 或者你可以去假市场。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.zh: 好的。
